name: print-social-candle-anatomy-diagram-post-on-bubblegum-pink
title: Candle anatomy post with five hand-drawn arrows around a ceramic bowl on pink
whatItIs: A bubblegum pink post with a red sparkle at the top left, a serif italic 'CANDLE' at the top right, a cutout white ceramic bowl candle with three wicks in the centre, five cream hand-drawn arrows pointing to labels (wick, scent, burn time, wax, handmade bowl) and a large yellow caps paragraph at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Clear and sweet; arrows turn product features into a readable diagram.
techniques: Radiate hand-drawn arrows from the product.
Use yellow and cream on pink.
End with a big caps paragraph.

vocabulary.definition: Labels arranged around a product with arrows.
